assets.prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render.
Asset type: art-direction concept paintover for the existing Star Agent hangar, NOT a game screenshot.
Input image: edit target, a screenshot of our current blockout. Preserve the camera viewpoint, room dimensions, clear empty walking aisle, elevator opening on the left, cargo terminal right of centre, right wall workbench and mezzanine. Preserve these functional locations and circulation. Remove all game HUD and UI overlays.
Primary request: show how this exact environment could look as a finished believable industrial orbital freight port. Original design informed by practical aerospace manufacturing, not copied branded assets. Maintain the large structural volumes; finish them with smaller manufactured assemblies.
Materials: warm ivory powder-coated upper wall panels; desaturated petrol blue lower protective panels; brushed stainless elevator leaves with dark rubber perimeter seals; charcoal non-slip deck with inset flush fasteners and restrained worn ochre pedestrian markings. Fine satin roughness variation, small paint chips around handles and impacts, clean maintained facility, no universal rust.
Construction: bevelled panel edges catch light, recessed joint shadow lines, bolted corner trims, louvred cabinet doors, terminal casing with chamfered shell, inset glass screen, card reader and real buttons. Workbench has drawers, vice and neatly placed tools. Add one restrained cargo vignette beside the right wall: two latched shipping cases on a dolly and a strapped supply pallet, all outside the existing walking aisle. Recessed fire extinguisher cabinet beside elevator. Two framed original station posters near the terminal, including a blue moon expedition image.
Lighting: warm practical task lights at terminal and elevator, cooler indirect illumination from the hangar opening, darker recesses and convincing local contact shadows. Legible exposure, no heavy fog, no dramatic cinematic darkness.
Composition: same eye-level screenshot framing, horizontal landscape. Prioritise believable material separation and human scale over more pipes or arbitrary greebles. Keep walking route fully clear, no floor cables, no new ship or people.
Text: only a small unobtrusive caption at bottom left reading "AEON — FINISH TARGET / CONCEPT". No HUD, no fake game telemetry, no copied company logos.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original in-world wall poster texture for Star Agent's orbital station. A finished portrait-format space travel poster, entire canvas is the flat print artwork, viewed perfectly front-on, no wall, no picture frame, no perspective, no shadows from an imagined room. Elegant industrial-era expedition poster: rugged pale lunar mountains in foreground, a tiny utilitarian survey rover for scale, a vast blue-white planet rising above the horizon and sparse orbital trajectory lines. Restrained petrol blue, ivory, charcoal, muted ochre; screen-printed grain and slight paper fibre texture, clean readable graphic composition. Top typography, exact text: "SELENE". Bottom typography, exact text: "THE NEXT HORIZON" and below it smaller "AEON EXPLORATION". Use only this text, no microtext, no additional slogans, no logos from real companies. Lettering crisp and professionally spaced. Full bleed portrait 2:3 composition, straight rectangular edges. This will be placed in a separately modelled poster frame in a game.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless tileable base-colour texture SOURCE for a game material, charcoal industrial non-slip resin coating on an orbital hangar deck. Flat orthographic view straight down, square image entirely filled by material, intended real-world coverage 2 by 2 metres. Fine dense dark graphite mineral aggregate bound into a matte grey resin coating, subtle low-amplitude neutral charcoal colour variation and very faint tiny directional abrasion, maintained working surface. No plates, no seams, no grooves, no large scratches, no yellow markings, no fasteners, no objects, no text, no border, no rust, no cracks. Uniform diffuse unlit appearance: no directional shadows, no lighting gradient, no highlights, no ambient occlusion, no vignette. Match all opposite edges for seamless horizontal and vertical repetition. Avoid distinct identifiable blotches or repeating focal marks. This is ONLY base colour, not a normal map, not a shaded preview or a multi-map sheet. Aim for restrained material realism that will receive lighting and roughness separately in a real-time renderer.
